title: Omitted Variable Bias in Difference-in-Differences Designs
abstract: arXiv:2609.19386v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the omitted variable bias (OVB) problem in canonical difference-in-differences (DiD) designs when unobserved confounding induces departures from the parallel trends assumption. Our results provide a novel characterization of the OVB formula for the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT), which is of independent interest. We show how the ATT bias is mainly governed by the strength of confounding in the treatment assignment mechanism and provide alternative ways of quantifying this strength, such as (i) changes in the average odds of treatment among the treated, (ii) confounding imbalance between treated and control units, or (iii) variation explained in treatment odds among the untreated. Building on these results, we offer sensitivity statistics for routine reporting, describing the minimum strength of confounding required to overturn the conclusions of a DiD study, as well as formal bounds on the strength of confounder

translated_title: 双重差分设计中的遗漏变量偏差
translated_abstract: 我们研究了标准双重差分设计中，当不可观测的混杂因素导致偏离平行趋势假设时出现的遗漏变量偏差（OVB）问题。我们的结果为处理组平均处理效应（ATT）的OVB公式提供了一种新颖的刻画，该结果本身具有独立的研究价值。我们展示了ATT偏差如何主要由处理分配机制中混杂因素的强度所主导，并提供了量化这种强度的多种替代方法，例如：（i）处理组中平均处理几率的变动，（ii）处理组与对照组之间混杂因素的不平衡程度，或（iii）未处理组中处理几率可解释的变异。基于这些结果，我们提供了可用于常规报告的敏感性统计量，用以描述推翻一项双重差分研究结论所需的最小混杂强度，以及混杂因素强度的形式化边界。
tldr: 本文为双重差分设计中处理组平均处理效应的遗漏变量偏差提供了新颖的刻画公式，并提出可常规报告的敏感性统计量，用于量化推翻DiD研究结论所需的最小混杂强度。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a novel characterization of the omitted variable bias formula for the ATT in difference-in-differences designs and introduces routine sensitivity statistics quantifying the minimum confounding strength required to overturn DiD study conclusions.
